scenes.aiSummary: Enari heals Kenzo; Izzarak flies and Kenzo jumps across the lava with the babies.

scenes.locationDetail: Far bank of the lava river
scenes.aiSummary: The party rests, scouts the flooded basin, and discusses Motua and the route ahead.

scenes.locationDetail: Jungle slope and flooded basin edge
scenes.aiSummary: Enari conceals the party as they approach the water and seek an ancient tree.
Kenzo speaks with an ancient tree, learns of Allua, and receives a sensory trail to her home.
The party follows the tree’s trail through strengthening currents to a nearly submerged tree.
Allua explains the babies’ link to Lengau and directs the party past the vortex toward the wounded Motua.
Enari rescues Kenzo while Izzarak becomes a salmon to escape the vortex with the babies.

scenes.locationDetail: Misty dry jungle beyond the vortex
scenes.aiSummary: The party emerges onto dry ground and searches through mist for the wounded serpent.
Kenzo heals three dream wounds while Izzarak destroys spiritual chains and Enari fights shadows; visions reveal Grash’s attack.
Motua explains Kenzo’s curse; Lengau returns, blesses the staff, and welcomes Izzarak and the babies.
Days pass as Kenzo trains, receives a tattoo, and asks Lengau to send him to Lastlight Falls.
scenes.time: Days of training after Motua is healed

scenes.locationDetail: Clifftop on the Amberglow side of the crossing
scenes.aiSummary: Kenzo arrives in the decaying Feywild realm; closing clarification revisits Grash’s theft of souls.

entities.label: Enari
entities.aiSummary: Enari heals and guides the party through the flooded jungle, rescues Kenzo, and fights shadows while Motua is healed.

entities.label: Ancient emergent tree
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo gives an ancient tree a voice and learns how flooding threatens it and Allua’s home; it supplies a sensory trail to its daughter’s tree.

entities.label: Allua
entities.aiSummary: The dryad Allua identifies the babies as potential successors to Lengau and explains how to approach Motua beyond the vortex. Her own tree is threatened by the current.

entities.label: Lengau’s two children
entities.aiSummary: The two shapeshifting young spirits travel under Izzarak’s protection and provide Lengau a route back into the forest. Their bond with Izzarak fixes their present lizardfolk forms.

entities.label: Motua
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo heals Motua’s three spiritual wounds by helping the souls within them, while companions fight the released chains. Motua explains Kenzo’s curse and blesses his staff.

entities.label: Lengau
entities.aiSummary: Allua identifies Lengau as the missing guardian who entrusted Izzarak with the babies. Lengau returns after Motua’s healing, blesses Kenzo’s staff, and sends him to the Feywild.

entities.label: Forgotten warrior in the first wound
entities.aiSummary: A nameless human warrior fears being forgotten; Kenzo records his story and heals the first of Motua’s wounds.

entities.label: Dying traveler in the second wound
entities.aiSummary: A nameless traveler dying in a desert asks Kenzo to preserve a final loving message to her family.

entities.label: Fearful paladin in the third wound
entities.aiSummary: A former thief fears damnation while holding off monsters so others can escape. Kenzo shares strength and his own history to restore the paladin’s hope.

entities.label: Priest in the paladin’s memory
entities.aiSummary: A priest appears in the paladin’s remembered past, assuring him that the Wildling accepts sincere repentance.

entities.label: Grash
entities.aiSummary: Motua’s memories reveal the skeletal attacker using a scroll, dark ring, and glaive to wound Motua and steal souls from the Land of the Dead. The DM identifies the attacker as Grash.

entities.label: The Wildling
entities.aiSummary: The priest in the paladin’s memory invokes the Wildling’s acceptance of those who honestly seek forgiveness.
entities.note: Gods and Religions/Gods/Incorporeal Gods/Mos Numena Pantheon/The Wildling.md

entities.label: Cloudspinner
entities.aiSummary: Lengau describes the vanished Queen of Sunset whose disappearance left Amberglow in decay.

entities.label: Somi-nai
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Somi-nai’s staff mark, and Allua names the fire spirit among those who raise the forest’s young guardians.

entities.label: Staff of the Forest Soul
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo uses his staff to speak with the ancient tree and record the wounded souls’ stories. Motua and Lengau imbue it with spiritual gifts, whose powers Kenzo studies during his stay.
entities.note: Campaigns/Dunmari Frontier Campaign/Treasure/Staff of the Forest Soul.md

entities.label: Kenzo’s ring of jumping
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo uses his ring to leap across the lava and attempts to jump around the vortex.

entities.label: Kenzo’s message stone
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo exchanges messages with Wellby while resting and later asks where they should reunite.

entities.label: Motua’s spiritual chains
entities.aiSummary: Nine chains emerge from Motua’s wounds; most are destroyed, but one binds Kenzo’s soul and imposes a lingering curse.

entities.label: Grash’s ancient scroll
entities.aiSummary: A vision shows Grash consuming an ancient scroll in dark fire to empower his ring and glaive.

entities.label: Grash’s burning ring
entities.aiSummary: The ring seen in Motua’s memories empowers Grash’s weapon and draws souls through cuts in the fabric of the Land of the Dead.

entities.label: Grash’s glaive
entities.aiSummary: Grash uses a glaive wreathed in dark fire to cut planar marks and wound Motua in the witnessed memories.

entities.label: Kenzo’s Dunmari horn
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo offers his horn as the personally meaningful sacrifice for a future restoration spell, but Motua cannot cast that spell.

entities.label: Apollyon
entities.aiSummary: Apollyon is proposed and immediately rejected as the identity of the skeletal attacker in Motua’s memory.

entities.label: Bhishma
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo identifies himself as a monk of Bhishma when offering to preserve the forgotten warrior’s story.

Allua describes Motua’s pain and location while the party searches for a peaceful remedy.
The party glimpses feathers and hears a wounded creature moving through the mist.
Kenzo enters and heals Motua’s three dream wounds while his companions fight the chains and shadows.
